fixtures.note: Type 1 (not +1) is always set with type 2/3 per the bitmask description; plan 03 owns exact bit policy.
Hello 6 only requires tracking; processing the packet after a gap (no retransmission exists) and the exact SeqErr bits are plan 03 policy.

fixtures.summary: Older packet arrives after a newer one
fixtures.note: Hello 6 says servers could check ordering; the drop-or-reorder choice is plan 03 policy, but stale output after newer data is never acceptable.

expect.late_packet: discarded or reordered, never output after newer data

fixtures.summary: Ping with an unrelated sequence between RT packets from the same port
refs: Hello 2.1 p7 (request/response sequence is per transaction)
fixtures.note: RT sequence tracking applies to IDN-RT commands only.

fixtures.summary: Wave timestamps wrap 2^32 with exact continuity
Wave timestamp jumps 1000 us past the previous chunk's end
fixtures.note: Whether the gap is filled, blanked or the channel resynchronised is plan 03's timing policy.

fixtures.summary: Two Void keepalive messages with the same timestamp
Close the only channel, then keep the link with an empty packet

refs: Hello 7.2 p32 (link SHALL time out after 1 s)

fixtures.summary: Empty close with ACK request as the first packet

segments.value: 0x45 RT graceful close with ACK request
0x41 RT channel message with ACK request

fixtures.summary: Exclude client group 1, then stream from group 1 with an ACK request
fixtures.note: Auth handling is device-configurable; a server with a non-empty code answers 0xFD instead.

segments.value: 0x41 RT channel message with ACK request

fixtures.summary: Route with SDM=1, then a wave chunk with SCM=2

expect.p1: dropped; configuration discarded; channel voided until a new configuration

fixtures.summary: Wave chunk without any prior routing
Valid routing, then an invalid replacement configuration (no Y) 200 ms later
refs: Stream 2.2 p10 (changes not faster than 100 ms)
fixtures.note: Plan 01 transactional compilation: a failed replacement must not leave a half-built decoder; whether the old layout survives is plan 02's decision, but p1's samples are never decoded with it.

fixtures.summary: Sequence gap, then ACK request reports and clears it
